svg.text: PACT — agentic framework: every agent in every workflow
Document update — only documents change, the design stays the same
Design validation — compare model with documents, change nothing
New powerbox — use a baseline if one exists, otherwise design from scratch
Design agents: all steps if no baseline · only changed parts if baseline
Common agents — each agent is built once; every workflow calls the same agent with its own instruction
Platform and tools shared by all agents (each agent can only use the tools on its own allowlist)
Used in: Doc = document update · Val = design validation · Mod = design modification · New = new powerbox
